pages.text: Deep in the stone, between the surface and the deepslate, there is an ore that glows faintly: $(l)Glimmerstone$(). Mine it with at least a stone pickaxe and it yields $(item)Dull Shards$().$(br2)They seem useless. They are not.
pages.title: The Awakening

pages.text: The shard hums when the sky grows dark.$(br2)Stand beneath an open sky during a $(l)thunderstorm$() with a shard in hand. Wait. The storm will find you. Rain works (storms are faster).
When it does, the shard is consumed and something in you wakes. You will feel a reservoir of $(l)mana$() that was always there.$(br2)You are no longer Mundane.
